title: lead-sync-micro-agenda-asha
body:
Quick notes for a short, high-velocity lead sync (15-20m). Goal: unblock engineering lead, align on 3 tradeoffs, confirm owners + next checkpoints. Keep it tight — use this as my talking crib, not a polished exec brief.

Context:
- Focus areas: API stability (hosted), Console rollout v2, Dedicated capacity onboarding, Private/KMS path.
- Recent signal: 95p latency for generate API rose ~12% last 7d after batching change (Samir rolled back yesterday). Need root-cause + safe remediation window.
- Console v2: canary users reporting missing model-selection dropdown in some orgs. UX flicker tied to feature flag evaluation latency.
- Dedicated onboarding: ACME corp billing discrepancy (overcommit vs. burst); finance loop started but we need a product-side mitigation (quota/notification).
- Private deployments: KMS integration PR has one blocking comment about key rotation API semantics (Maya).

Micro-agenda (15-20m):
1) 2m - quick tempo check (how are you, any immediate micro-blockers?)
2) 5m - API latency snapshot & plan (decide rollback vs. mitigation)
   - ask: do you want me to pause the customer-facing incident message or keep it open?
3) 5m - Console canary issue: hotfix / rollback / feature-flag kill switch decision
4) 4m - Dedicated / Private items: billing mitigation + KMS PR owner assignment
5) 2m - Confirm owners, deadlines, and 1-week follow-ups

Talking points / prompts for Diego:
- On latency: what telemetry do you trust right now? Are we seeing degraded throughput or just tail latency? (FYI: Staging heap looked fine, but warm cache rates down ~18% for 2 token prefixes)
- On batching change: was the change intended to prioritize throughput at expense of tail latency? Can we surface a quick guardrail in runtime to cap batch size for API tier 1?
- Console: is the FF eval call hitting an external service? If yes, can we short-circuit to a safe default for orgs where it times out?
- Dedicated billing: can we apply a temporary safe-mode that caps burst usage and sends the org an in-console alert while finance sorts invoices?
- Private/KMS: what is the smallest API change that resolves Maya's concern (one-line semantics doc + test)?

Quick metrics to read out (so we can decide):
- API generate 95p: last week 1700ms -> now 1900ms (12% up)
- API p50: 210ms -> 230ms (modest)
- Request success rate: 99.93% -> 99.90% (spike in timeouts + retries)
- Console canary error rate: 0.4% -> 1.8% for flagged orgs
- Dedicated onboarding tasks open: 6 (2 blocked on billing, 1 on infra, 3 on docs)

Proposed decisions I want in this meeting:
- Latency: Rollback batching change to previous config for hosted API tier-1 + schedule a deeper RCA (owner: Samir; target: rollback within 2h if Diego approves)
- Console: disable feature-flag evaluation fallback to external service; enable static safe default for 24h while we patch (owner: Diego; target: 24h)
- Dedicated billing: Product to draft in-console notification + auto-cap until dispute resolved (owner: me - Asha; support: Finance & Diego; target: 48h)
- Private/KMS: assign Maya to finalize PR with key-rotation doc; if not done in 3 days, escalate to Diego for decision

Action items (capture in Slack + Linear after meeting):
- Samir: prepare rollback play (commands, expected impact, smoke test) — due 2026-03-12 EOD
- Diego: approve/trigger rollback + FF kill switch — due ASAP (same meeting)
- Asha (me): draft in-console billing notice + cross-post to CS & Finance — due 2026-03-13 noon
- Maya: resolve KMS semantics comment + small test case — due 2026-03-15
- Ops: run smoke suite on hosted after rollback and post results in #infra-alerts — due within 1h post-rollback

Notes-to-self / things to mention if time:
- Remind Diego that rollback will increase short-term cost per token (because smaller batches) — preempt objections from finance.
- Offer to host a 30m RCA with Samir + runtime owners tomorrow to dig into kernel selection tradeoffs.
- Ask SRE for a short-lived dashboard focused on eval FF latency across regions (help debug console canary)

Potential follow-ups (post-meeting):
- If rollback happens: send customer incident update template (I have a draft in Confluence) and coordinate CS.
- If rollback blocked: propose a canary config (apply to 10% of traffic) and monitor 95p for 2 hours before wider rollout.

Conversation cues (to keep it human):
- "You're doing great handling the burst — what's the smallest thing I can do right now to make your life easier?"
- "If we can't fully fix in 48h, what's the lowest-risk mitigation we can commit to?"

End state I want: clear decisions, owners with deadlines, and a short public note (CS + customers if impacted) within 2 hours.

Random scratch reminders (delete later):
- Pull the console canary logs for org IDs: 1045, 1102, 1181
- Check GH PR 2198 comments for a potential perf regression (search for 'ff-eval' keyword)
- Add a follow-up agenda for next week: rollout telemetry, cost delta analysis, and ingress routing policy

Meeting prep done. If Diego seems swamped, prioritize rollback + billing mitigation and defer KMS semantics deep dive.

-- Asha
